docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: These are resources for FiveM (GTA V roleplay servers). They support Qbox, ESX and QBCore; the badges at the top of every script page show which frameworks it works with, and Browse by framework groups them.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• A FiveM server. OneSync is recommended; it's on by default on current servers.
  • The framework the script is built for.
  • The other resources listed on the script's page. ox_lib is recommended for the nicest notifications, and Qbox already includes it.

docs.title: Installing a script
docs.text:
1. Open the script's page in Scripts and follow the latest release link.
  2. Download the .zip file under Assets.
  3. Unzip it into your server's resources folder.
  4. Add the script's items to your inventory (see below).
  5. Add ensure <resource name> to server.cfg, below your framework (see below).
  6. Restart the server.

docs.title: Adding items
docs.text:
Where items go depends on your framework and inventory. Each script page shows the exact code for its items.

ESXQBCoreQbox Inventory Where items go Default ESX Run the script's .sql file on your database ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua Inventory Where items go qb-inventory / ps-inventory qb-core/shared/items.lua ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua

Item images go in your inventory's image folder, for example qb-inventory/html/images/.

Inventory Where items go ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua

Qbox uses ox_inventory. Item images go in ox_inventory/web/images/.

docs.title: server.cfg order
docs.text:
Resources start from top to bottom, so your framework and its libraries must come before any script that uses them.

ESXQBCoreQbox 
ensure oxmysql
ensure es_extended
ensure ox_lib          # optional
ensure <script name>

ensure oxmysql
ensure qb-core
ensure [qb]            # qb-inventory and other qb resources
ensure ox_lib          # optional
ensure <script name>

ensure oxmysql
ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory
ensure <script name>

If you installed with the Qbox txAdmin recipe, keep its order and add your scripts at the end.

docs.title: Giving items for testing
docs.text:
Framework Command ESX /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount] QBCore /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount] Qbox (ox_inventory) /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount]

Police jobs on QBCore and Qbox

Scripts that count police usually only count officers who are on duty. If a script says there aren't enough police, make sure the officers have clocked in.

docs.title: Updating a script
docs.text:
1. Check the Changelog on the script's page for anything new you need to set up.
  2. Back up your old config files (for example config/config.lua and config/config_server.lua).
  3. Delete the old script folder and put the new release in its place. Don't copy the new files over the old ones, because files can move between versions.
  4. Copy your changed values back into the new config file. Don't copy the old file over it, because new versions can add settings.
  5. Restart the script with ensure <resource name> in the server console, or restart the server.

docs.title: Finding errors
docs.text: If something doesn't work, look at the server console and the F8 console in game. Errors show the resource name, for example [tobs_bankrobbery]. Each script page has a Troubleshooting section for the common ones.

docs.title: Getting help
docs.text: Open an issue on the script's GitHub repository. Include your framework, the script version and any error from the consoles.

docs.title: tobs_bankrobbery
docs.text:
v2.0.0 Qbox · ESX · QBCore 6 languages GPL-3.0

Rob the Paleto Bay bank and all six Fleeca banks. Hack the security panel, open the vault and empty the trolleys before the police arrive.

Download Installation Source

docs.title: At a glance
docs.text:
Frameworks Qbox, ESX and QBCore, detected automatically Banks Paleto Bay (B1) and six Fleeca banks (F1–F6) Uses when running ox_lib, ox_target, ox_inventory, qb-inventory, ps-dispatch Languages English, Danish, German, Swedish, Norwegian, Dutch License GPL-3.0, free and open source

Formerly tobs_blaine, and the numbers start at 1.0.0 again

tobs_bankrobbery replaces the separate tobs_blaine downloads. The version you can download is 2.0.0. The next one is 1.0.0, which comes after it: the script was rewritten enough that the numbering was restarted. See the changelog.

vRP servers

vRP is supported up to 2.0.0, the last version with it. From 1.0.0 the script is Qbox, ESX and QBCore only.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Secure by design

    The server runs every step of the heist and every payout, so mod menus can't skip the hack or fake loot.

    How it works

  • Fun to play

    Laptop hack, thermite, the real bank alarm, deposit boxes to drill, and gold and diamond trolleys.

    Loot and rewards

  • A real chase

    Police alerts and dispatch, plus an optional GPS tracker or dye pack hidden in the loot.

    Police and the chase

  • Built for admins

    Discord logs, an admin reset, restart protection, saved cooldowns and exports for your scripts.

    Server tools

docs.text: Download from GitHub Releases. Versions before 2.0.0 were released as tobs_blaine, with separate ESX and vRP downloads that shared the same code from 1.3.0. The numbering restarts at 1.0.0 with the next release, so the newest version will have the lowest number: 1.0.0 comes after 2.0.0.

docs.title: Coming soon
docs.text:
Built and tested outside the game; not in a released version yet. It will be released as 1.0.0 (the numbering restarts), and it drops vRP: vRP servers stay on 2.0.0.

  • Minigames from tobs_minigames: GTA Online's hacking laptop and drilling screen, GTA V's safe dial and nine more minigames, when tobs_minigames runs
  • Minigames per bank, for example GTA's laptop and drill at Paleto
  • Heist switch: /tobpause stops new heists without a restart
  • Test mode: /tobtest for a full heist with no police, crew or cooldown rules, and no pay

docs.title: 1.0.0 · not released yet
docs.text:
The server now runs the whole heist, and trolleys pay by the time spent grabbing. This was written as 2.1.0 while it was being built; it will be released as 1.0.0, without vRP and with the framework code shared with the other tobs_ scripts.

  • Security: every step and timer runs on the server, so cheaters can't skip the hack, open the vault early, loot before it's open, or keep it open. Grabbing faster pays nothing more, and players drill one deposit box at a time
  • Rewards: a full trolley pays TOB.TrolleyCash ($50,000–80,000) over TOB.GrabTime seconds. TOB.mincash, TOB.maxcash and TOB.MaxPiles are gone
  • Crew takeover when the robber disconnects
  • Any hacking minigame (TOB.HackMinigame)
  • ps-dispatch alerts out of the box, and SV.DispatchAlert for server-side dispatch
  • Events and exports for other resources
  • ox_lib text prompts instead of 3D text (TOB.Prompts)
  • Optional GPS tracker and dye pack in the loot
  • Marked bills with a worth value for QBCore / Qbox laundering
  • Cash and cooldown per bank (Fleeca trolleys now hold $30,000–50,000); banks moved to config/banks.lua
  • Trolleys spawned by the server with OneSync, and the gate uses GTA's door system
  • German, Swedish, Norwegian and Dutch
  • Players who join the server during a heist can loot it too
  • Cooldowns survive restarts; the countdown shows for the whole crew; the police blip lasts the whole heist; full pockets don't lose loot; a warning when OneSync is off

Updating from 2.0.0: replace the folder and copy your settings into the new config files. Set TOB.TrolleyCash instead of the old pile settings.

docs.title: 2.0.0 · 2026-09-21
docs.text:
tobs_blaine is now tobs_bankrobbery: one download for every framework. The heist itself is the same as 1.5.0.

  • Qbox, ESX, QBCore and vRP in one resource, detected automatically (TOB.Framework)
  • Qbox and QBCore support: only on-duty police count (TOB.PoliceOnDuty), items through ox_inventory or qb-inventory
  • TOB.PoliceJob can be a list of jobs, for example {"police", "sheriff"}
  • /bankcoords prints your position for adding banks
  • Item files for every inventory in the install/ folder
  • TOB.blackmoney = "auto" and TOB.Notify = "framework"

Updating from tobs_blaine: delete the old tobs_blaine folder, change ensure tobs_blaine to ensure tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg, and copy your settings into the new config/ files. vRP servers: English is now the default language (set TOB.Locale = "da" for Danish).

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: Gameplay settings are in config/config.lua, the banks in config/banks.lua, and server-only settings in config/config_server.lua. The "auto" settings pick the best system you have running, so most servers only change the heist and reward values.

docs.title: Framework and police
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.Framework "auto" "auto" finds qbx_core, es_extended or qb-core. Or set "qbox", "esx" or "qb" TOB.PoliceJob "police" Qbox / ESX / QBCore job that counts as police. Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"} TOB.PoliceOnDuty true Qbox / QBCore: only officers on duty count

docs.title: Heist
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.mincops 4 Police needed online to start TOB.hacktime 60000 Hack duration in milliseconds TOB.timer 300 Seconds to loot after the vault opens TOB.VaultCloseDelay 30 Seconds before the vault closes after looting TOB.cooldown 600 Seconds before the bank can be robbed again TOB.MinCrew 1 Robbers needed near the panel to start TOB.CrewRadius 15.0 Meters around the panel that count as near TOB.OneAtATime false Only one heist on the server at a time TOB.GlobalCooldown 0 Seconds after any heist before any bank can be robbed (0 = off)

docs.title: Minigame
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.HackMinigame "ox_lib" "ox_lib" (skill check, skipped without ox_lib), "none", or your own function. See Hacking minigame. Coming soon: any tobs_minigames game such as "hack", and minigames per bank TOB.MinigameDifficulty {"easy", "easy", "medium", "medium"} ox_lib: one entry per round: "easy", "medium" or "hard" TOB.MinigameKeys {"w", "a", "s", "d"} ox_lib: keys the skill check can ask for TOB.CardTime 150 Coming soon: seconds the robber has for the card, the laptop and the minigame before the heist fails

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.TrolleyCash {min = 50000, max = 80000} Cash in one full trolley (3 per heist) TOB.GrabTime 37 Seconds to empty a trolley. Stopping early pays for the time spent TOB.black false Pay dirty money. ESX: the black_money account. Others: the TOB.blackmoney item TOB.blackmoney "auto" Dirty money item: black_money on Qbox and QBCore (ESX uses its black_money account) TOB.RewardItem "" Pay as an item instead. See Loot as items TOB.RewardItemCount "cash" "cash" or the number of items in a full trolley TOB.MarkedBills false Pay each trolley as one TOB.MarkedBillsItem with its value as worth. See Marked bills TOB.MarkedBillsItem "markedbills" Item used for marked bills

docs.title: GPS tracker and dye pack
docs.text:
See GPS tracker and Dye pack. Both are off by default.

Option Default Description TOB.Tracker.enabled false Hide a GPS tracker in some loot TOB.Tracker.chance 30 % chance per grabbed trolley TOB.Tracker.duration 180 Seconds police can follow the robber TOB.Tracker.interval 5 Seconds between position updates TOB.Tracker.warnRobber true Tell the robber they're tracked TOB.DyePack.enabled false Hide a dye pack in some trolleys TOB.DyePack.chance 20 % chance per trolley TOB.DyePack.loss 0.25 Part of the trolley's value that's ruined TOB.DyePack.dirty true Pay the rest as dirty money TOB.DyePack.smoke 10 Seconds of red smoke on the robber

docs.title: Vault item
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.VaultItem "" Item needed to open the vault. See Vault item TOB.VaultItemLabel "thermite" Name shown to players TOB.VaultItemTime 15000 Milliseconds spent on the vault door

docs.title: Inner gate (Fleeca)
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.GateItem "" Item needed for the second panel, e.g. "secure_card". "" = none TOB.GateItemLabel "Secure ID Card" Name shown to players TOB.GateHackTime 10000 Milliseconds the gate hack takes

docs.title: Animations and grabbing
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.TrolleySpawn "auto" Who spawns the trolleys: "auto" (the server with OneSync, otherwise the leader's game), "server" or "client" TOB.LaptopHack true Laptop hacking animation at the panel TOB.VaultItemAnim "thermite" Vault item animation: "thermite" or "weld" TOB.Alarm true Play the bank's alarm (Paleto). Fleeca is silent TOB.StopGrabKey 73 (X) Key to stop grabbing early. false = can't stop TOB.LootCounter true Show cash grabbed and heist totals TOB.SpecialTrolleyChance 25 % chance one trolley is gold or diamonds TOB.SpecialTrolleys gold 2×, diamonds 3× Models, pay multiplier or item per type

docs.title: Deposit boxes
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.DepositBoxes true Drillable deposit boxes in the vault TOB.DrillItem "drill" Item needed (not used up). "" = none TOB.DrillTime 15000 Milliseconds per box TOB.DrillMinigame {"easy", "medium"} ox_lib skill check while drilling ({} = none), or your own function. Coming soon: any tobs_minigames game such as "drill" TOB.DrillRewards cash (weighted) What a box can hold. See Deposit boxes

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.Locale "en" "en", "da", "de", "sv", "no" or "nl". See Translations TOB.Target "auto" "auto", "ox_target" or "none" (press E) TOB.Prompts "auto" "Press E" prompts: "auto" (ox_lib text UI when running, otherwise 3D text), "ox_lib" or "3d" TOB.Progress "auto" "auto", "ox_lib" or "progressBars" TOB.Notify "auto" "auto", "ox_lib", "mythic_notify", "framework" (Qbox, ESX or QBCore notifications) or "native" TOB.NotifyTitle "Bank Robbery" Title on ox_lib notifications TOB.CoordsCommand "bankcoords" Command that prints your position for adding banks. false = off

docs.title: Police
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.BuiltInPoliceAlert true Built-in alert and blip. Turn off if your dispatch script handles it TOB.Dispatch "auto" "auto" (ps-dispatch if running, else TOB.DispatchAlert), "ps-dispatch", "custom" or "none". See Dispatch TOB.DispatchAlert empty Your own dispatch call, run in the robber's game

docs.title: Server (config/config_server.lua)
docs.text:
This file is never sent to players.

Option Default Description SV.Webhook "" Discord webhook URL. See Discord logs SV.LogAntiCheat true Also log blocked cheat attempts SV.ResetCommand "tobreset" Name of the reset command SV.CheckForUpdates true Check GitHub for a new version on start SV.BlockBeforeRestart 15 Minutes before a txAdmin restart when new heists are blocked (0 = off) SV.DispatchAlert empty Server-side dispatch or logging when a heist starts. See Dispatch SV.PauseCommand "tobpause" Coming soon: name of the heist switch command SV.TestCommand "tobtest" Coming soon: name of the test mode command SV.TestModePayouts false Coming soon: test heists pay like normal heists SV.CheckCommand "tobcheck" Coming soon: name of the health check command SV.HealthCheck true Coming soon: run the health check when the server starts SV.ShowPoliceCount false Coming soon: "not enough police" says how many are needed and on duty. See Why a heist can't start SV.BankSoundRange 40.0 Coming soon: meters around the bank where players hear the drill and the vault door

Banks are in TOB.Banks in config/banks.lua. TOB.FleecaBanks = false (in config/config.lua) turns off all 6 Fleeca banks. A bank can have its own cash = {min, max} and cooldown; the Fleeca banks pay $30,000–50,000 per trolley. See More banks.

docs.title: Optional features
docs.text:
Everything here is off by default, or switches itself on when the resource it needs is running. Defaults and the full setting list are in Configuration; the admin commands, logs and exports are in Server tools.

Coming soon

Rows marked soon are built and tested outside the game, but aren't in a released version yet.

docs.title: Loot and rewards
docs.text: Feature What it does Setting Grabbing A full trolley pays over TOB.GrabTime seconds; X stops early and keeps what's in the bag TOB.TrolleyCash, TOB.StopGrabKey, TOB.LootCounter Gold and diamond trolleys One trolley can hold gold (2×) or diamonds (3×). A missing model falls back to cash TOB.SpecialTrolleyChance, TOB.SpecialTrolleys Deposit boxes 8 boxes per vault to drill while it's open, once each, with a drill item. Cash, items or nothing, by weight TOB.DepositBoxes, TOB.DrillRewards, TOB.DrillItem Loot as items Pay an item instead of cash. Full pockets never lose loot: players are told to make room TOB.RewardItem, TOB.RewardItemCount Marked bills One bag per trolley with its value on the item ({worth = ...}), for QBCore and Qbox laundering. Needs qb-inventory or ox_inventory; ESX pays cash TOB.MarkedBills

docs.title: Heist rules
docs.text: Feature What it does Setting Crew size Robbers must stand near the panel to start. Without OneSync every online player counts TOB.MinCrew, TOB.CrewRadius Stopping bank chains One heist at a time on the server, and a cooldown on every bank after any heist TOB.OneAtATime, TOB.GlobalCooldown Restart protection Blocks new heists before a txAdmin restart, so nobody loses one halfway. Skipping the restart allows them again SV.BlockBeforeRestart Vault item The robber opens the vault by hand with thermite or a drill, staying near the bank. The item is used up TOB.VaultItem, TOB.VaultItemTime Crew takeover If the leader disconnects, the nearest crew member leads the rest of the heist — Why a heist can't start (soon) Every refusal says why, with the time left. "Not enough police" hides the numbers unless you show them SV.ShowPoliceCount

docs.title: Police and the chase
docs.text:
Feature What it does Setting Dispatch ps-dispatch works out of the box; any other dispatch script through a hook TOB.Dispatch, TOB.BuiltInPoliceAlert GPS tracker Some loot hides a tracker: police follow the robber on the map for a few minutes. Needs OneSync TOB.Tracker Dye pack Some trolleys burst into red smoke when the grab ends, ruining part of the money TOB.DyePack Using another dispatch script

Paste the alert call from its documentation into one of these. An error in your code doesn't stop the heist; it shows in the console.

Client-side dispatchServer-side dispatch

In config/config.lua, runs in the robber's game:

TOB.DispatchAlert = function(coords, bank)
    -- your dispatch script's alert, using coords
end

In config/config_server.lua, runs on the server:

SV.DispatchAlert = function(bank, coords, playerId, label)
    -- your dispatch script's server-side alert
end

With ps-dispatch, add camId = 1 to a bank in config/banks.lua to attach a camera.

docs.title: Look and feel
docs.text:
Feature What it does Setting Hacking minigame The minigame before the hack, and the one for the boxes: an ox_lib skill check, none, a tobs_minigames game, or your own function TOB.HackMinigame, TOB.DrillMinigame, TOB.CardTime Minigames from tobs_minigames (soon) GTA Online's hacking laptop and drilling screen, GTA V's safe dial and nine more ensure tobs_minigames Minigames per bank (soon) Each bank can use its own; Paleto comes with GTA's laptop and drill minigames in config/banks.lua Animations and alarm The laptop hack, thermite sparks, the real Paleto alarm, and (soon) everyone nearby hearing the drill and the vault TOB.LaptopHack, TOB.VaultItemAnim, TOB.Alarm, SV.BankSoundRange Translations English, Danish, German, Swedish, Norwegian and Dutch, all in locales/locales.lua TOB.Locale Your own minigame, and the tobs_minigames games

Any function works as a minigame, as long as it returns true when the player passed:

TOB.HackMinigame = function(bank)
    return exports["my_minigame"]:Start(...) -- see that resource's documentation
end

With tobs_minigames running (ensure it above tobs_bankrobbery), a setting can also name one of its games: "hack", "drill", "safe", "thermite", "keypad", "wires", "lockpick", "fingerprint", "hotwire", "lasers", "keyfiling" or "tracker". The GTA drill replaces the progress bar, since it can't be finished faster than TOB.DrillTime. Without tobs_minigames, or if a GTA screen doesn't load, the normal minigame runs instead.

Per bank, in config/banks.lua:

B1 = {
    label = "Paleto Bay (Blaine County Savings)",
    minigames = {hack = "hack", drill = {type = "thermite", difficulty = "hard"}},
    ...

To add a language, copy the en block in locales/locales.lua, rename it, translate it and keep the %s and %d placeholders.

docs.title: Your own banks
docs.text:
The banks live in config/banks.lua: Paleto (B1) and the six Fleeca banks (F1–F6). Turn one off with enabled = false, all Fleeca banks with TOB.FleecaBanks = false, and give any bank its own cash and cooldown.

Adding a bank

Copy a bank's block, rename it (for example B2) and fill in the positions. Stand on each spot in game and type /bankcoords: it prints your position and heading ready to paste.

Setting What it is doors.startloc The "Start bank heist" panel. animcoords is where the player stands gate The security gate: position, closed angle (h) and prompt position (txtloc) vault The vault door and its prompt position prop.first Where the used card is left trolley1–trolley3 The 3 trolley spawns, with angle (h) objects The same 3 spots, used for cleanup doors.secondloc Optional second panel that opens the gate, like Fleeca label The bank's name in Discord logs minigames (soon) This bank's own hack and drill minigame

Banks with other door models can set gateModel and vaultModel (a model name or a hash number).

docs.title: The heist
docs.text:
1. At least TOB.mincops police must be online (on QBCore and Qbox: on duty), and at least TOB.MinCrew robbers must be at the panel.
  2. A player with a Malicious Access Card uses Start bank heist at the bank's security panel (press E, or with ox_target).
  3. The card is used up and police are alerted. At Paleto, the bank alarm starts ringing.
  4. The robber opens a laptop at the panel and plays the hacking minigame: an ox_lib skill check, or GTA Online's hacking laptop at banks that use tobs_minigames (Paleto by default). Failing it, or taking longer than TOB.CardTime, ends the heist.
  5. The hack runs for TOB.hacktime (1 minute by default).
  6. If a vault item is set, the robber has TOB.timer seconds to plant thermite on the vault door, which then burns through.
  7. The vault opens. The crew has TOB.timer (5 minutes) to loot the 3 trolleys, with a countdown at the bank. Grabbing pays for the time spent, and X stops early. At Fleeca banks the third trolley is behind an inner gate that has to be hacked from a second panel. See Grabbing, gold and diamond trolleys and the deposit boxes.
  8. When every trolley is empty or the time runs out, the vault closes after TOB.VaultCloseDelay seconds. The bank goes on cooldown (TOB.cooldown, 10 minutes). Everyone sees what they got, and the crew's total.

The heist also ends if the robber leaves the bank. If the robber disconnects, the nearest crew member at the bank takes over and leads the rest of the heist. Heists can also be blocked by the global rules, restart protection or an admin's heist switch; the player is always told why.

docs.title: For police
docs.text:
• Every officer gets an alert, and a flashing red blip marks the bank until the heist ends. Officers who go on duty during a heist get the blip too.
  • Officers can lock and unlock the security gate and the vault door.
  • Police can't start or loot the heist.
  • Using a dispatch script? See Dispatch.

docs.title: Anti-cheat
docs.text:
The server runs the whole heist: every step, every timer and every payout. Players' games only ask, so mod menus can't skip steps or fake payouts:

  • The vault only opens when the server says the hack (and the vault item) is done. Nobody can open it early.
  • Trolleys can only be looted while the vault is open, and the Fleeca gate trolley only after the gate is hacked.
  • Trolleys pay for the time actually spent grabbing, never more than the trolley holds, and only at the trolley.
  • Each trolley can be looted once per heist, and a player drills one deposit box at a time, for as long as drilling takes.
  • Only police can lock and unlock the doors. The robber's gate and vault are opened by the server.
  • Starting, looting and drilling check that the player is there. This needs OneSync; without it the console shows a warning.
  • A heist that somehow gets stuck ends automatically, and cooldowns survive restarts.

Blocked attempts can be posted to Discord.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: Pick your framework once and every tab on this site follows.

docs.text:

Turn on OneSync

OneSync is on by default on current servers. The anti-cheat, the GPS tracker and the server-spawned trolleys use it to know where players are.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
1. Download tobs_bankrobbery-vX.Y.Z.zip from the latest release.

  2. Unzip it into your server's resources folder, so you get resources/tobs_bankrobbery/.

  3. Add the items. The install/ folder has them ready for every inventory. Players need the Malicious Access Card (id_card_f) to start a heist, and a drill for the deposit boxes (or set TOB.DrillItem = "").

    QboxESXQBCore

    Copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua:

    ['id_card_f'] = {
    label = 'Malicious Access Card',
    weight = 10,
    stack = true,
    close = true,
    description = 'A cloned access card used to breach bank security systems.',
},

    Item images go in ox_inventory/web/images/.

    Default inventory: run install/esx.sql on your database.

    ox_inventory: copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua.

    qb-inventory: copy the items from install/qb-core.lua into qb-core/shared/items.lua:

    id_card_f = { name = 'id_card_f', label = 'Malicious Access Card', weight = 10, type = 'item', image = 'id_card_f.png', unique = false, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'A cloned access card used to breach bank security systems.' },

    Put an image for each item in your inventory's image folder, for example qb-inventory/html/images/.

    ox_inventory: copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.

  4. Set your police job in config/config.lua:

    QboxESXQBCore

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}. Only officers who are on duty count (TOB.PoliceOnDuty).

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}.

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}. Only officers who are on duty count (TOB.PoliceOnDuty).

  5. Add it to server.cfg, below its dependencies:

    QboxESXQBCore 
    ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

add_ace group.admin command.tobreset allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobpause allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobtest allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobcheck allow

    ensure es_extended
ensure ox_lib        # recommended
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

add_ace group.admin command.tobreset allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobpause allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobtest allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobcheck allow

    ensure qb-core
ensure [qb]          # qb-inventory and other qb resources
ensure ox_lib        # recommended
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

add_ace group.admin command.tobreset allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobpause allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobtest allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobcheck allow

    The add_ace lines let admins use the reset command and (coming soon) the heist switch, test mode and health check. If you use tobs_minigames, put ensure tobs_minigames above ensure tobs_bankrobbery.

  6. Running another Fleeca heist script? Set TOB.FleecaBanks = false in config/config.lua so the two don't clash.

  7. Restart the server. The console shows [tobs_bankrobbery] Version ... is up to date.

The framework is found automatically

If the console says No framework found, move ensure tobs_bankrobbery below your framework, or set TOB.Framework to "qbox", "esx" or "qb".

docs.title: Giving players the access card
docs.text:
The script doesn't hand out cards. The card is used up each heist, so price it with that in mind.

QboxESXQBCore
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to an ox_inventory shop (ox_inventory/data/shops.lua)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to a black-market shop (for example esx_shops or ox_inventory shops)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to a shop in qb-shops (or an ox_inventory shop)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions

docs.title: Updating
docs.text:
Delete the old folder, unzip the new release, then copy your changed settings into the new config/ files. Check the changelog for anything new to set up.

Coming from tobs_blaine

tobs_bankrobbery is the new name of tobs_blaine. Delete the tobs_blaine folder, change ensure tobs_blaine to ensure tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg, and copy your settings into the new config/config.lua. The items and the /tobreset command are the same.

docs.title: Server tools
docs.text:
For the people running the server: what gets logged, which commands admins have, and how other resources can follow the heists.

Coming soon

Rows marked soon are built and tested outside the game, but aren't in a released version yet.

docs.title: Commands and checks
docs.text:
Tool What it does Setting Discord logs A message when a heist starts and ends (with each player's payout), on admin resets, and when the anti-cheat blocks something SV.Webhook Admin reset /tobreset [bank] closes the vault, removes the trolleys and clears the cooldown SV.ResetCommand Heist switch (soon) /tobpause [reason] stops new heists server-wide; /tobpause off allows them again SV.PauseCommand Test mode (soon) /tobtest lets one admin run heists with no rules, no cooldown and no pay SV.TestCommand, SV.TestModePayouts Health check (soon) Lists missing items, resources, permissions and settings on start and with /tobcheck SV.HealthCheck Update check Says in the console whether you have the latest version SV.CheckForUpdates For other resources Events and exports so dispatch, MDT or admin scripts can follow the heists —

Admin commands need the add_ace lines from Installation, or run them from the server console.

Events and exports 
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:heistStarted", function(bank, playerId, coords) end)
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:vaultOpened", function(bank) end)
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:heistEnded", function(bank, reason, totalCash) end)
Export Returns IsHeistActive(bank) true while that bank (or any bank, without an argument) is being robbed GetHeist(bank) {stage, leader, started, label} or nil GetBanks() a list of {bank, label, active, cooldownLeft} ResetHeist(bank) resets the bank like /tobreset, returns true

All on exports.tobs_bankrobbery.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Check the server console and the F8 console first. Errors show tobs_bankrobbery.

Coming soon: the health check lists most setup problems in the console on start, and /tobcheck runs it again.

docs.title: Starting a heist
docs.text:
“Not enough police” but police are online
  • Qbox / QBCore: only officers who are on duty count. Clock in, or set TOB.PoliceOnDuty = false.
  • Your police job or group has a different name. Set TOB.PoliceJob in config/config.lua.
  • To test on your own, use /tobtest: it skips the police, crew and cooldown rules.
No “Start bank heist” prompt
  • Police can't start heists.
  • With ox_target running there's no floating text: target the panel. TOB.Target = "none" brings back press E.
  • The bank is on cooldown or already being robbed.
“You need 2 robbers at the panel (1 here)”

TOB.MinCrew is set above 1. More robbers need to stand within TOB.CrewRadius meters of the panel.

“Bank heists are paused”

An admin paused heists with /tobpause. /tobpause off allows them again, and so does a server restart.

“The city restarts soon”

A txAdmin restart is scheduled within SV.BlockBeforeRestart minutes. Set it to 0 to turn this off.

Fleeca heists clash with another script

Set TOB.FleecaBanks = false to keep only Paleto.

docs.title: Items, inventory and payouts
docs.text:
“You don't have a malicious access card” but I have one

The item must be named exactly id_card_f. See Installation.

“You need a drill to open the deposit boxes”

Add a drill item to your inventory, or set TOB.DrillItem = "" so no item is needed.

Items aren't found on QBCore

If ox_inventory is running, the items must be in ox_inventory/data/items.lua; otherwise in qb-core/shared/items.lua. See Installation.

“Your pockets are full”

The player's inventory can't take the loot items. They can make room and keep grabbing; a deposit box stays closed so it can be drilled again.

Payouts are too high or too low

Each trolley pays TOB.TrolleyCash when fully grabbed; a heist has 3 trolleys plus the deposit boxes. Change TOB.TrolleyCash and TOB.DrillRewards. The Discord log shows what every player got.

docs.title: Minigames, prompts and notifications
docs.text:
The minigame doesn't appear

The default minigame needs ox_lib. Put ensure ox_lib above ensure tobs_bankrobbery, use another minigame, or turn it off with TOB.HackMinigame = "none".

Paleto shows the ox_lib skill check, not GTA's laptop or drill

GTA's screens come from tobs_minigames. Start it above tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg. Without it, or if a GTA screen doesn't load, the normal minigame runs on purpose.

Error about progressBars

Without ox_lib the script uses progressBars. Install either one.

No notifications

Set TOB.Notify to what you run, for example "ox_lib", or "native" for GTA notifications.

docs.title: Admin commands and logs
docs.text:
No permission for /tobreset, /tobpause, /tobtest or /tobcheck

Add the add_ace lines from Installation to server.cfg, or run the command in the server console (not /tobtest: it's for players in game).

Discord logs don't arrive

Check SV.Webhook in config/config_server.lua is the full URL and the webhook still exists. The logs are also printed in the server console.

“Bank … is missing … and was skipped” in the console

A bank in TOB.Banks is missing a setting (for example after a copy-paste). The console names the bank and the missing settings. The other banks keep working.

docs.title: Server setup
docs.text:
“No framework found” in the console

tobs_bankrobbery started before your framework. Move ensure tobs_bankrobbery below ensure qbx_core, es_extended or qb-core, or set TOB.Framework in config/config.lua.

Error: attempt to index a nil value (global 'Bridge')

No framework was found when the script started. See “No framework found” above.

“OneSync is off” in the console

Add set onesync on to server.cfg. Without OneSync the server can't see where players are, so the anti-cheat can't check that players are at the bank.

Police don't see the GPS tracker

TOB.Tracker needs OneSync (the server sends the robber's position). The console warns at startup when it's off.

docs.title: Models and animations
docs.text:
Gold or diamond trolleys look like cash trolleys

Their models are from game build 2060. Set sv_enforceGameBuild 2060 (or newer) in server.cfg; they still pay the gold/diamond multiplier either way.

The vault room or doors look wrong

Check that stream/v_int_41.ytyp is inside the tobs_bankrobbery folder.

The laptop or thermite animation looks off

Animations are placed from the bank's positions in the config, so a custom bank may need tuned positions. Turn them off with TOB.LaptopHack = false or TOB.VaultItemAnim = "weld", and please report it on GitHub.

Still stuck? Open an issue on GitHub with your framework, version and the error.
